stages.name: Stage 1 — Chapter 1: Leonida Keys
stages.text: Open the game, earn the first story trophies, and — before anything else — do the balcony meditation at Jason's house after Down to Earth. Meet Kenton. Start scanning vehicles.

stages.name: Stage 2 — Chapters 2–3: Vice City opens
stages.text: Coffee Break unlocks duo play. Jewelry jobs, the Key Cloner, the Scooter Bros app and most character questlines arrive. Build the scanning and studying habits now.

stages.name: Stage 3 — Chapters 4–5: the endgame story
stages.text: Finish the named missions, unlock bank vaults through the cafe mission, and take the story gold. Every trophy quest giver returns after the credits.

stages.name: Stage 4 — The 100% checklist
stages.text: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the list: all robberies, 33 underwater discoveries, 42 range golds, drone races, Bret's decks, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges.

stages.name: Stage 5 — Strangers, freaks and the odd jobs
stages.text: Finish the stranger strands and the character lines left over, then the one-off trophies: the UFO, the tank, the showroom Banshee, the bike kicks.

stages.name: Stage 6 — Platinum
stages.text: When the 54th other trophy lands, Vice Got a Price! unlocks by itself. Check the audit strip: 55 official, 1,350 PSN points.

timeline.closes: Balcony meditation (Positive Mental Attitude — possibly required), Shirley's two errands, house magazines
Nothing permanently: Kenton's diving pauses here and returns in Chapters 2–3
Timed optional missions expire shortly after appearing; no trophy needs them
Nothing closes; this OPENS duo play, which partner trophies and the final meditation require
Nothing trophy-related: free-roam continues, the 100% checklist appears, all quest givers return
Cheats disable trophies and saving for the session; the Irredeemable profile is permanent

watchList.name: Positive Mental Attitude
watchList.why: Chapter 1 balcony meditation may be required and locks at the end of Chapter 1.

watchList.name: Kenton's questline
watchList.why: Pauses after Chapter 1 — not missable, but do not mistake the pause for a lock.

watchList.name: Stranger chains (Andy, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret)
watchList.why: One secondary report claims story-linked windows; the fuller guide says all return after the story. Start them when they unlock to be safe.

watchList.name: Irredeemable criminal profile
watchList.why: Permanent once reached, and police turn far more aggressive — it never blocks a trophy, but it makes everything slower.

watchList.name: Cheats
watchList.why: Any cheat disables trophies and saving for the session. Keep them off for the whole run.
